notes: Revenant: Hollow-touched survivors (standard rig). A cold, pale, stitched face (black thread seams, a mouth sewn shut) in a pressure-suit patched together from many wrecks: the suit is the tinted outfit, brown and rust patches are salvage. A life-support pack on the back (two tanks, a dead gauge), ring pauldrons whose lamps no longer light, and a hose that dangles behind (in the legs layer: it sways with the walk). Eyes are two faint cold dots: head_glow has 2 frames per head variant (a slow flicker, ~1 fps). Head variants: bare, hood (a salvaged cloth hood, tinted), helmet (a dented pressure helm with a dead lamp). Outfit mask = the suit, the harness straps, the hood. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 1 fps
